# Source Tier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SourceTier`](gmeow-SourceTier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceTier>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The bibliographic tier of a source — primary, secondary, or tertiary — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). This is the standard source-tier axis applied to notability assessment (cf. WP:GNG).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SourceTier`](gmeow-SourceTier.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:sourceTier`](../properties/gmeow-sourceTier.md) — the standard primary/secondary/tertiary bibliographic axis — when classifying a cited source for notability assessment.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the source's independence ([`gmeow:SourceIndependence`](gmeow-SourceIndependence.md)) or coverage depth ([`gmeow:CoverageDepth`](gmeow-CoverageDepth.md)), which are orthogonal [`Axis`](gmeow-Axis.md) B vocabularies, and avoid per-tier subclasses; the tiers are individuals.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded tier individuals via [`gmeow:sourceTier`](../properties/gmeow-sourceTier.md) on the citation; combine with independence and coverage depth so the solver can weigh notability, and let competing tier assessments coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### Examples

- ex:secondary a [`gmeow:SourceTier`](gmeow-SourceTier.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "secondary"@en.
